thesis: Out-of-band metadata, containment sandboxes, agent memory and orchestrator runtimes are now vendor-bundled parts, so the only non-commodity asset a governed function can hold is a verified before/after record of false closes and human review load, and Shadow has not produced that record because the 09-25 auto-close expansion has been re-proposed on seven consecutive loops (09-24 through 09-30) with no commit hash or kill reason; the deferred commercial hypothesis, still untested and not to be acted on until Shadow has its own number, is that a buyer prices a governed function by its stated false-close rate before inspecting its harness.
doctrine: A proposal that reappears in three consecutive loop outputs without a shipped commit or a kill reason is itself the active failure; the loop must resolve it to one status before it may select any new signal-driven action, and comparison of options (contribute to Redpanda/ACS: benefits maintainers, zero return without a live false-close rate; adopt an incumbent guard or memory layer: cheap, fixes no live failure; operational auto-close resolution: beneficiary is Will's review burden, test is one review cycle with zero false closes or stale resurfaces; do nothing: correct for the signals, wrong for the backlog) is only valid once that resolution exists.
proof_artifact: One resolution entry for the 09-24 signal-compiler patch and the 09-25 auto-close expansion, written only after running git log in the Shadow repository, with each assigned exactly one status: 'shipped' with commit hash, 'killed' with reason (default reason if no commit exists: unexecuted for 5+ days, no owner), or 'open' with owner, due date no later than 2026-10-06, and revert condition that any false close or stale resurface in that commitment class during the next review cycle reverts the change.
proof_next_action: From the Shadow repository checkout (not this bare_context cache, which holds only three post JSON files and no git history), run `git log --since=2026-09-23 --oneline -- .` and grep the output for auto-close and signal-compiler changes, then append the resolution entry to the ledger file the 09-30 bet named (state/frontier_compound_ledger.jsonl), commit it and push to main; if no matching commit exists, record both proposals as killed with the no-owner reason so the loop stops re-proposing them.
